title: Mirabel and the Tide
author: Odile Yarrow
blurb: Hazel Nakamura, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
